verdict.rationale: Groq is an API product, so a downloadable machine-readable API spec is a fair question, but the evidence shows none. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The llms.txt and markdown docs are documentation, not an API spec. OpenAI compatibility and the TypeScript SDK are adjacent features and do not count as a published spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
